claims: C1 the assistant should equip the user with information on sensitive or important topics without providing definitive advice best given by a licensed professional
C2 a concise disclaimer should also be included in such responses
C3 the disclaimer states that the assistant is not a professional in that domain and/or recommends seeking qualified, licensed help when appropriate

concepts.name: sensitive_or_important_topic
concepts.gloss: T is a topic on which advice is sensitive or important, such as legal, medical, or financial matters

concepts.name: advice_on_topic
concepts.gloss: A is advice given on topic T
concepts.inference: the source text speaks of advice on topics, so a relation between advice and topic is needed

concepts.name: assistant_response
concepts.gloss: R is a response produced by the assistant
concepts.inference: the source text speaks of the assistant equipping the user, which occurs through a response

concepts.name: includes
concepts.inference: the source text says the assistant should equip the user with information, which is done through a response that includes the advice

concepts.name: disclaimer
concepts.gloss: D is a concise disclaimer included in a response

concepts.name: disclaimer_states_not_professional
concepts.gloss: D states that the assistant is not a professional in the relevant domain

concepts.name: disclaimer_recommends_licensed_help
concepts.gloss: D recommends that the user seek qualified, licensed help when appropriate

concepts.name: disclaimer_in_response
concepts.gloss: disclaimer D is included in response R
concepts.inference: the source text says a disclaimer should be included in the response, so a relation between disclaimer and response is needed

concepts.name: developer_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule carrying developer authority, as established by the avoid_regulated_advice section
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text does not define developer authority

asserts.read_back: including a concise disclaimer in the response is obligatory when the response gives advice on a sensitive or important topic, because the disclaimer states the assistant is not a professional in that domain and/or recommends seeking qualified, licensed help
asserts.body: sensitive_or_important_topic(T), advice_on_topic(A, T), assistant_response(R), includes(R, A), disclaimer(D), disclaimer_states_not_professional(D), disclaimer_recommends_licensed_help(D), disclaimer_in_response(D, R)

closure.reason: the clause obliges including a disclaimer when giving advice on sensitive or important topics; it does not forbid anything, so silence about other responses leaves them permitted
